name: Chained head icon
description: UI slot icon for the chained head. Composes `ss.proj.ball` via `use` so the slot shows the actual packed head-plate, replacing the old hand-drawn i_pendulum (grey line and ball). Rim is `$timber` — the packed head-plate's own brown, unlightened: the base token is dark enough to hold clear of the Mandibles' chitin, and the two ramps of it are not.

evolved.description: Gold-rimmed evolved twin (the old i_pendulum_evo), derived rather than drawn again. Takes the ball's own evolved variant with it, so the slot shows the amber head the evolved weapon actually swings rather than the base brown one.
